# vLLM (fork branch b70/lmx-20261021 @ cfd2b6ffdb8f) + out-of-tree b70_gguf_xpu / b70_x5_xpu plugins, one Arc Pro B70, no speculative decoding
B70_D3_GDN_SPEC=0 B70_X5_BATCH_LINEAR=0 B70_X5_CANONICAL=1 B70_X5_EVENTLESS=1 B70_X5_EVENTLESS_LAZY=1 B70_X5_GDN_BF16=1 B70_X5_GDN_MIXED=0 B70_X5_GDN_RAGGED=0 B70_X5_PACK_LINEAR=1 B70_X5_Q8_FAST=1 B70_X5_Q8_LINEAR=1 MAX_LEN=65536 MTP_TOKENS=0 QUANT=UD-Q4_K_M X5_LMX=1 B70_GGUF=1 B70_FUSE_SHARED=1 B70_PREFILL=0 \
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B --load-format b70_gguf --quantization b70_gguf (GGUF Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-UD-Q4_K_M.gguf) \
  --tensor-parallel-size 1 --dtype bfloat16 --max-model-len 65536 --max-num-seqs 2 --max-num-batched-tokens 1024 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 --language-model-only --attention-backend FLASH_ATTN --no-enable-prefix-caching \
  --compilation-config '{"mode":0,"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_DECODE_ONLY","cudagraph_capture_sizes":[1,2,3,4,6,8]}'  (no --speculative-config)

engineTimingsRaw.provenance: vLLM server usage and isolated global metric deltas; not per-request engine timings

parsed.notes: One Intel Arc Pro B70 (32 GB, Xe2, kernel 7.1, Compute Runtime 26.22). vLLM 0.32 main + thin XPU fork (local branch b70/lmx-20261021, commit cfd2b6ffdb8f, based on vLLM main 5fd62688, not pushed) with our out-of-tree GGUF XPU plugin (custom SYCL MoE/GEMV kernels for Q4_K/IQ formats, BF16 GDN kernel, Q8 linear path), BF16 activations, full-decode XPU graphs. Unsloth Dynamic GGUF loaded by the plugin (MTP head present in the file but unused). No speculative decoding: no --speculative-config, server config speculative_config=null, zero draft tokens in the server counters, one token per forward pass. max_model_len 65536, prefix cache off, greedy (temperature 0), thinking on (server default; reasoning tokens counted as output), 512 max tokens, 1 warmup + 3 timed iterations with a new leading cache-bust nonce, median decode-rate sample. Client-observed HTTP streaming (lmx remote method); engineTimingsRaw holds vLLM usage plus isolated Prometheus counter deltas (vLLM has no per-request timings object). promotion gate: all checks pass except exact_repeat, c4_paris (detail follows). Gate detail: c4_paris compares against a fixed 16-token continuation recorded on a different quant; this Q4_K_M gives a different, coherent continuation (" Paris, a city renowned for its iconic landmarks such as the Eiffel Tower,"). Exact repeat: both C1 passes bitwise identical (4 prompts x 96 forced tokens); in the second of two C2 (2-request batch) passes one prompt diverged at token 34, i.e. batch-2 decode in this recipe is not run-to-run bitwise stable (known GDN reduction race, fixed after this engine snapshot). This submission is single-stream (C1), where repeats are exact; the 3 timed samples are 97.0-97.3 tok/s.

parsed.promptSample:
Implement a small command-line tool in Python called `logtally`.

Requirements:
- It reads newline-delimited JSON log records from stdin. Each record has `ts` (ISO-8601 string), `level` (one of DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR), `service` (string), and optional `latency_ms` (number).
- It prints, per service, the count of records by level and the p50 and p95 of `latency_ms` (ignore records without latency).
- Malformed lines must be counted and reported at the end, never crash the program.
- Support a `--since <ISO timestamp>` flag that drops earlier records.
- Use only the standard library.

After the code, explain in two or three sentences how you computed percentiles and why you chose that method, then list three edge cases a unit test suite should cover.
